dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I imagine most people think of academia as so strict and rigorous that they think scholars are uninterested in works of fiction.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: But in reality, if your thinking is too rigid, you're likely to get stuck in your research.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Yes, stories might be pure fabrications, but sometimes they can give us just the inspiration we need to move our research forward.
